# archestra_chatops_telegram (Resource)

The organization's Telegram integration, so people can chat with agents in Telegram. One per organization. The bot token is write-only: the API never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Destroying the resource turns the integration off and keeps the stored token. Enabling it checks the token with Telegram.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "telegram_bot_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "archestra_chatops_telegram" "this" {
  bot_token = var.telegram_bot_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Telegram bot token from BotFather.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is on.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the stored configuration is complete.
- `id` (String) Integration name.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the configuration was last saved.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_chatops_telegram.this telegram
```
